plugin.name: 2K - recommended
plugin.description: Xtudo's black textures at 2K. What the set was authored around, and about 90 MB of VRAM less than 4K for a difference you will not see on a cuirass.

plugin.name: 4K
plugin.description: The same textures at 4K. Worth it for close screenshots; otherwise it is VRAM for nothing.

plugin.name: 1K
plugin.description: The same textures at 1K, for a machine that is short of VRAM.

plugin.name: HIMBO - prebuilt male meshes
plugin.description: The cuirass, boots, gauntlets and first-person arms refitted to HIMBO (zeroed sliders, so OBody and its kind work out of the box), from Trexasle's Legacy of Ysgramor - HIMBO Conversion. Overrides the male meshes; the helmet has no body under it and is unchanged.

plugin.name: HIMBO - BodySlide files
plugin.description: Slider sets and shape data to build the male set to your own HIMBO preset in BodySlide, under the group "Nordic Skyforged - HIMBO".

plugin.name: CBBE 3BA - BodySlide files
plugin.description: Slider sets and shape data to build the female set to your CBBE 3BA preset in BodySlide (no physics), from Xonek's Legacy of Ysgramor - 3BA Bodyslide, under the group "Nordic Skyforged - CBBE 3BA". Nothing is prebuilt: build them once in BodySlide.
